about: Wetaskiwin County No. 10 is a municipal district in central Alberta surrounding the separate City of Wetaskiwin—not the city itself. Hamlets, farms, and lake country such as Pigeon Lake approaches share parkland agricultural territory between Edmonton and Red Deer. About 11,000 people live in Wetaskiwin County.
